title: Indoor Carbon Dioxide Metric Analysis Tool
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology

license.name: United States government work; NIST Technical Series publication

units.space_volume: litre in equations; user-interface units are converted

measurement_uncertainty.description: The registered equations provide analytical single-zone calculations rather than measured observations.

known_gaps: The QICO2 single-zone model assumes equal balanced inflow and outflow and ignores air-density differences.
It excludes within-zone gradients, multizone transport, and infection-risk calculations.
Occupant CO2 generation is an input whose uncertainty must be handled separately in empirical use.

preprocessing.description: Verify the exact public NIST QICO2 technical-note PDF by signature, byte size, and SHA-256 without creating a derived dataset.

permitted_use.purpose: Analytical verification of balanced single-zone CO2 concentration and storage
permitted_use.notes: The source is a United States government publication. NexusEP requires attribution for scientific traceability.
